title: Patch: a dungeon or Assault fight that has ended keeps its result when the player leaves before Continue
thread:
**Issue #4733 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4733: Patch: a dungeon or Assault fight that has ended keeps its result when the player leaves before Continue
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a dungeon run's fight ends, the board shows Victory or Defeat with two buttons, Continue and Menu. Right now the result counts only if the player presses Continue. If they press Menu instead, reload, close the tab, or swipe back on a phone, the game forgets the fight was ever played. The next time they open the run, the same fight starts again from turn one.

So a player who won has to win the same fight a second time. A player who lost, or conceded, gets a free retry, although losing a fight is meant to end the run. Once this is built, the result is kept the moment the fight ends. Coming back takes the player to wherever Continue would have taken them. The new Infinite Assault mode isn't open to players yet but has the same gap (minus the Menu button), and it gets the same fix before it ships.

## Why

- The worker clears the kept fight as soon as the game is over. `crates/shared/src/host/practice/host.rs:468` saves only while `!self.is_over()`, and `apps/web/src/practice/driver.ts:169-171` writes that empty save into the run's or the Assault's slot. R3476000 and R4582001 both say "A finished fight clears the slot".
- The result is held only in the fight screen's memory until it is sent. In the dungeon, only Continue sends it (`apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx:164`, `dungeon.act(action)`). In the Assault, Continue and Menu send it (`apps/web/src/assault/fight/FightScreen.tsx:167`, `:214`).
- The dungeon's Menu sits on the result panel beside Continue and only navigates: `dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx:181-182` is `navigate(paths.play)`. R3932000 wrote down that Menu "navigates to the Play menu directly" once the fight has its result, without saying that the result is then lost. The Assault's Menu sends the report first (R4582001).
- Once the fight is over, both screens release their leave guard (`atStake` requires `!over`, dungeon `:195`, Assault `:196`). The browser's Back and the phone's back swipe therefore leave without asking.
- When the player comes back, the run or attempt is still on that fight. The screen tries to resume, finds no kept fight, and deals it fresh from the same seed (dungeon `:116`, Assault `:120`). The tests `R3476000 a fight no save folds for is dealt fresh from its seed` and `R4582001 a fight no save folds for is dealt fresh from its seed` pin that fallback.
- That breaks the run's own rules. §15 says "one lost fight ending the run" and, of a fight's end, "Any other end drops HP to zero and ends the run" (`spec/15-dungeon-run.md:3`, `:213`). R3932000 says "conceding a fight ends the whole run for good". A win's added max HP and refill (§15, R3584000) are lost until the fight is won again.
- No test leaves a finished fight any way but Continue and checks the result. `R3932000 once the fight has its result Menu goes to Play without asking` (`dungeon/fight/FightScreen.test.tsx:593`) checks only the navigation.
- The Assault is still closed (`ASSAULT_OPEN = false`, `apps/web/src/assault/config.ts:5`, release #4597). Fixing it now keeps the gap out of the release.

## Proposal

1. **Hold the result as soon as it arrives.** When the worker answers `runReport` / `assaultReport`, the fight screen hands the action to its store. The store writes it beside the kept run (`dungeon/store.ts`) or the kept attempt (`assault/store.ts`, `ASSAULT_ATTEMPT_KEY`) as a held report, keyed to the fight it is for. It is the run's own outcome action, which the page already has, never the game's log (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Holding it changes no screen. The board keeps showing its end until Continue, so R4582000's rejection of "reporting automatically on arrival, which cuts the board's end" still holds.
2. **Continue applies it** as it does today, and the same write clears the hold.
3. **Leaving applies it.** If the fight screen unmounts with a held report it has not sent, it applies it. That covers the dungeon's Menu, the browser's Back and any in-app move. The dungeon's Menu thus sends the result first, as the Assault's does (this amends R3932000's last paragraph).
4. **Loading applies it.** A store that loads a kept run or attempt still on the fight its held report is for applies the report once. That covers a reload and a closed tab. The player lands where Continue would have put them: the map, the run's end, or the Assault's after-level or Lost screen. If the run refuses the held report, the hold is dropped and the fight is dealt fresh, as today.
5. **One ruling note** in this issue's block, `spec/rulings/R<N>000.md`, says the above. It cites §15.6, R3476000, R3932000, R4582000 and R4582001, and its §11 paragraph goes in `spec/pending/<N>.md`.

Decisions this leaves open, settled here:

- The hold lives on the page, not in the worker. Rejected: keeping the worker's finished save until the result is taken. That would change the shared crate's practice host, which saves no finished game (R668), and would add a resume path for a game that is already over.
- Rejected: writing on `pagehide`. It misses in-app moves and is unreliable on phones.
- A reload within the worker's one round trip between the game ending and its report still deals the fight fresh. That window is accepted.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts`: hold, apply, clear. The kept run gets an optional held report, and older kept runs without it still parse.
- `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx`: hand over on arrival; Menu and unmount apply.
- `apps/web/src/assault/store.ts` and `apps/web/src/assault/fight/FightScreen.tsx`: the same.
- Tests: `dungeon/fight/FightScreen.test.tsx`, `dungeon/store.test.ts`, `assault/fight/FightScreen.test.tsx`, `assault/store.test.ts`.
- `spec/rulings/R<N>000.md` and `spec/pending/<N>.md`. SPEC §15.6, R3476000, R3932000, R4582000, R4582001. The dungeon and Assault paragraphs of `apps/web/README.md` where they describe Menu.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Dungeon: a won fight, then Menu, then back to the dungeon. The run is past that fight with the win's max HP and refill, and no fight is dealt.
- [ ] Dungeon: a lost or conceded fight, then Menu. The run has ended lost and its record is in the history, as after Continue.
- [ ] Dungeon and Assault: a finished fight whose report has arrived, then the store reloaded from storage (the test reset seams). The report is applied once, the hold is cleared, and no fresh fight is dealt.
- [ ] Dungeon and Assault: the fight screen unmounted after its report arrived, without Continue. The report is applied once.
- [ ] Continue applies exactly once, and Continue followed by a reload or an unmount applies nothing more.
- [ ] Holding a report changes no screen: the board's end stays until Continue. The existing R4582000 and R3932000 tests pass, adjusted only where R3932000's Menu now sends first.
- [ ] A held report the run refuses is dropped, and the fight is dealt fresh.
- [ ] A kept run or attempt written before this change, with no hold, still loads.
- [ ] Tests named `it("R<N>000 …")` sit in the note's `proven_in`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` passes on the four touched test files.

## Size and risks

Medium: about eight files in `apps/web`, one ruling and its pending paragraph, and no Rust. The main risk is applying a result twice, through Continue then an unmount, or through two tabs (both stores reload from storage on a `storage` event). Clearing the hold in the same write that appends the action closes that. The remaining risk is the round-trip window above.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Area: `client` (`suggestions.areas`).

Class: `data` → `priority:high`; relabel to change it.

**Judge:** would approve it: Confirmed on main: the practice host clears a finished fight's save (host.rs:468), the dungeon's Menu next to Continue only navigates (FightScreen.tsx:181), and the kept run has nothing marking the fight as played, so a lost or conceded fight gets a free retry, which breaks §15's one lost fight ending the run. With no vote, no comment and no 👎 on this issue by Wed 25 Nov 06:48 CST, it is approved by itself at `priority:low` (at most 3 a day); comment `reject`, or anything at all, to decide it yourself.

## Goal

A dungeon or Infinite Assault fight that has ended keeps its result the moment its report arrives. Leaving by Menu, Back, reload, or closed tab applies the held result exactly once, landing where Continue would have taken the player. Clear the hold in the same write that appends the result, so Continue-then-leave and two-tab races apply nothing twice. One ruling note, `R4733000`, with its `spec/pending/4733.md` paragraph.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|

| `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx` | change | Hold on arrival, send-once, Menu sends first, unmount sends |
| `apps/web/src/assault/config.ts` | change | Add `ASSAULT_HELD_KEY` constant |

## Steps

1. **Ruling and pending note.** Write `spec/rulings/R4733000.md` (front matter `id: R4733000`; title: `A finished dungeon or Assault fight keeps its result when the player leaves before Continue (issue #4733)`; `cards: "§15.6, R3476000, R3932000, R4582000, R4582001, issue #4733"`; `proven_in` listing the four test files above). Body: the report is held beside the kept run/attempt keyed to its fight when it arrives, holding changes no screen (R4582000 still holds); Continue applies it and clears the hold in the same write; unmount applies an unsent held report; loading a kept run/attempt still on that fight applies it once, else drops it and deals fresh; a refused held report is dropped. State that this amends R3932000's last paragraph (Menu now sends first). Write `spec/pending/4733.md` with the matching `**[[R4733000]] … (issue #4733, <today's date>)**: …` paragraph, linking the same sections and rulings.
2. **Dungeon held-report storage.** In `apps/web/src/dungeon/config.ts` add `export const DUNGEON_HELD_KEY = "jackioh.dungeon.held";`. In `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts` add `type HeldReport = { row: number | null; col: number; action: RunAction }`, `parseHeldReport` (reject unless `v` matches, row is null or a count, col is a count, action is a record with `type: "fightOver"`), and `readHeld`/`writeHeld`/`clearHeld` on `DUNGEON_HELD_KEY` using the existing `readJson`/`writeJson`/`removeStored` helpers.
3. **Dungeon hold and apply-on-load.** Add `holdReport(action: RunAction): void` to the `Dungeon` type; implement `holdFightReport` reading `core?.live`, returning silently unless the live run's phase is `fight`, writing `{ row: live.run.row, col: live.run.col, action }`; expose it in `useDungeon`'s memo. In `loadCore`, after `live = folded` succeeds: read the hold; if none, proceed as today; if the run is finished or not on a fight with matching row/col, `clearHeld()` and proceed; else apply once via the existing `step(core, live, held.action)` and `clearHeld()` in the same tick whether it returns a string (refused: dropped, run stays on its fight, dealt fresh since the worker's slot is clear) or a `Core`. Also `clearHeld()` in the unreadable-run branch, the `"gone"` branch, `startRun` (beside `clearStoredRunFight`), and `abandonRun`. In `step`, call `clearHeld()` on both success paths (the `persistRun` branch and the settled branch), so every successful act clears any hold in its own write.
4. **Dungeon fight screen.** In `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx` add `dungeonRef` mirroring the existing `setupRef` pattern. Add `heldFor`/`sentRef` refs and a `sendOnce` callback that returns unless `action !== null && controller !== null && sentRef.current !== controller`, then marks sent and calls `dungeonRef.current.act(action)` (keeping the existing `setSent` state for the disabled button and refusal line). Hold on arrival: `useEffect(() => { if (action !== null && controller !== null && heldFor.current !== controller) { heldFor.current = controller; dungeonRef.current.holdReport(action); } }, [action, controller])`. `onContinue` becomes `sendOnce`; `onMenu` becomes `if (action !== null) sendOnce(); navigate(paths.play)`. Unmount: `const sendRef = useRef(sendOnce); sendRef.current = sendOnce; useEffect(() => () => { sendRef.current(); }, [controller])`. Error reports never hold and Retry is unchanged.
5. **Assault held-report storage and store.** In `apps/web/src/assault/config.ts` add `export const ASSAULT_HELD_KEY = "jackioh.assault.held";`. In `apps/web/src/assault/store.ts` add `type HeldAssault = { attempt: number; level: number; action: AssaultAction }`, parse with the existing `parseAction` requiring `kind === "fightOver"`, plus read/write/clear helpers. Extract `actOn`'s reduce+persist+record block into `commitAction(from: Core, action: AssaultAction): Core | string` (identical behavior, `removeStored(ASSAULT_HELD_KEY)` on its success paths); `actOn` calls it and commits. `loadCore`: after a successful `foldAttempt`, read the hold; drop it when the state is terminal or not a fight with matching `setup.attempt`/`level`, else apply once through `commitAction` in the same tick (terminal handling as today). `startAttempt` and `dismissResult` clear the hold. Add `hold(action: AssaultAction): void` to the `Assault` type (silently returns unless state phase is `fight`; writes attempt, level, action) and to `useAssault`'s memo.
6. **Assault fight screen and page.** In `apps/web/src/assault/fight/FightScreen.tsx` add required prop `onHold: (action: AssaultAction) => void` with an `onHoldRef` mirror; hold-on-arrival effect and `sendOnce`/unmount cleanup exactly as the dungeon screen (replacing `send`), with `onMenu` keeping its shape (`if (!atStake) sendOnce();` then `onLeave`/navigate). In `apps/web/src/assault/AssaultPage.tsx` pass `onHold={(action) => { assault.hold(action); }}` to `AssaultFightScreen`. Settled: after a reload, a won fight lands on the next level's Briefing, not the page-local `AfterLevelScreen` (which is not persisted); lost still lands on `LostScreen` via store phase.
7. **Tests.** Dungeon screen: extend `fakeDungeon` with `holdReport: vi.fn()`; add `it("R4733000 the report is held on arrival, before Continue")` (hold called with `LOST`, `act` uncalled, Continue still enabled), `it("R4733000 Menu after the report sends the report first, then goes to Play")`, `it("R4733000 unmounting after the report applies it once, without Continue")` (call `cleanup()` after the report enables Continue; expect `act` once with `LOST`), `it("R4733000 Continue then unmount applies nothing more")`. The existing R3932000 Menu test needs no change (it asserts only navigation, no dialog). Assault screen: pass `onHold: vi.fn()` in `renderFight`; add `it("R4733000 the report is held on arrival")`, `it("R4733000 unmounting after the report sends it once")`, `it("R4733000 Continue then unmount sends nothing more")`. Dungeon store: `it("R4733000 a held won report applies on load, once")` (start, `go`, `holdReport`, `reload()` → phase map with `fightOver` appended, hold key gone, second `reload()` appends nothing), `it("R4733000 a held lost report ends the run as after Continue")` (history record, run key gone), `it("R4733000 a held report the run refuses is dropped and the fight is dealt fresh")` (`runReduce` refuses once; run stays on fight, hold gone). Assault store mirrors these three against attempt phases (`briefing` next level / `lost` / still `fight`). Pre-change kept values without a hold are already covered by the existing B19/R4581001 reload tests; name that in the test comments.
8. **Checks.** Run `cargo jackioh spec check`, then `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/dungeon/store.test.ts`, `src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.test.tsx`, `src/assault/store.test.ts`, `src/assault/fight/FightScreen.test.tsx` (each builds the WASM module first), plus `cargo fmt --check` if any Rust was touched (none expected).

## Tests

Each new test is named `it("R4733000 …")` and asserts the behavior in step 7: hold-on-arrival without sending or screen change; Menu/unmount applying exactly once; Continue-then-unmount/reload applying nothing more; refused holds dropped with the fight dealt fresh; lost fights settling history/records as Continue does. Existing R4582000/R3932000/R3476000/R4582001 tests must pass unchanged (the R3932000 Menu-navigation test now exercises send-first navigation). Commands: the four `pnpm --dir apps/web test <file>` invocations above and `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Won fight, then Menu: run past that fight with the win's max HP and refill (or attempt on next level's Briefing), no fresh fight dealt.
- [ ] Lost or conceded fight, then Menu: run ended lost with history record (or attempt Lost screen), as after Continue.
- [ ] Reload with an arrived report: applied once, hold cleared, no fresh fight; Continue or unmount after that applies nothing more.
- [ ] Unmount with an arrived report, without Continue: applied once.
- [ ] Refused held report dropped; fight dealt fresh; pre-change kept values without a hold still load.
- [ ] Board's end unchanged until Continue; existing R4582000/R3932000 tests pass.
- [ ] `R4733000` tests in all four files, listed in the note's `proven_in`; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] The four `pnpm --dir apps/web test <file>` runs pass.

## Risks

- Double-apply (Continue then unmount; two tabs via `storage` event): closed by clearing the hold in the same synchronous tick that appends the action; the second path finds no hold and a finished run/attempt refuses (`"The run is over."` / `"The attempt is over."`). Do not reorder the clear after an await.
- Dev-only StrictMode remount runs the unmount cleanup early; `sentRef` plus the store's refusal make the duplicate a harmless no-op. Production is unaffected.
- Rule 7: only the outcome action crosses into the store; the log and hidden hands stay in the worker. The store's row/col and attempt/level keys are the player's own position, not hidden information.
- Reload inside the worker's single round trip between game end and report arrival still deals the fight fresh; accepted per the issue, no test covers it.

## Open questions

None. Every decision the task left open is settled above: page-side hold (not worker-kept finished save), no `pagehide` writer, fight-identity keying, clear-on-Continue-attempt, Briefing landing for reloaded Assault wins, and no README change.
```
